findings.summary: searchContract.search_panel has serialization/schema but no frontend consumer.
workflowContract lacks a closed schema for availableActions/actions/statusbar/transitions/evidenceGate.
intake autosave runtime is wired with an empty field set and does not consume runtimeContract.intakeAutosave.
nativeActionContract readiness and non-cache runtime control-plane declarations are not runtime gates/behaviors.
calendar, gantt and dashboard use readable-record fallbacks rather than equivalent interactive surfaces.
64 formal entries currently have only declared-empty read evidence; 16 have read/detail only and 3 have surface-only evidence.
No business-entry evidence records the research baseline SHA as its served/source identity.
The 12-entry core ORM smoke and the 91-entry product CSV share only 4 exact menu XMLIDs; its other 8 results cannot be rebound by label or model inference.
The formal operation capability matrix prints search=0 for all 81 rows because it reads the obsolete layout searchProfile location instead of root searchContract.
Four of twelve declared UX journeys lack browser evidence, and the role journey audit script maps multiple journey IDs to the same first route instead of executing distinct tasks.
